items.t: The S&P 500 Has a “Pure Value” Version. RPV Gives Its Cheapest Stocks the Biggest Weights
items.sum: Most S&P 500 funds hand the biggest weights to the market's winners. One lesser-known fund flips that logic, loading up on unloved health insurers, automakers, and refiners. Does it deserve a spot in a retiree's portfolio, or is the discount a trap?

items.t: Ambetter from Meridian Returns to Metro Detroit for 2027 Marketplace Open Enrollment
items.sum: Ambetter from Meridian today announced its return to the Health Insurance Marketplace in Wayne, Oakland, Monroe and Macomb counties, giving individuals and families in Metro Detroit another option as they shop for health insurance coverage for the 2027 plan year.
